regulations.enforcement_body: Town of Castle Rock Business Licensing
regulations.notes: The Town of Castle Rock does NOT have specific STR regulations (as of December 2023). However, all STR operators must obtain a Town business license and collect and remit applicable lodging and sales taxes. No special STR permit or zoning approval is required beyond the standard business license.
